metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the wait, the note, the unbound book, and the afternoon bill.

yesterday: Let him finish. The empty yard changed more than the louder reading.
A king who listens frights more than one who shouts. Use it. The note was written at the Theatre.
The Plutarch is unbound, on the shelf. Daniel's third book is tomorrow. The Holinshed is still out.
The afternoon was Richard III. The roll had the play and the hour. The three words on the tables stayed as they were.
